page.purpose: Heading of the after-send lists on their own page.
page.where: The /after-send page (not in the sidebar; for building and checking the lists), page heading.

stale.title.purpose: Heading of the list of rekordbox playlists to delete by hand.
stale.title.where: After-send lists, first section (also the send checklist's last step).

stale.hint.purpose: Explains why the user deletes these playlists and where they come from.
stale.hint.where: After-send lists, under the stale-playlists heading.
stale.hint.approved: In rekordbox, right-click each of these playlists and choose Delete Playlist. They come from crates that were renamed or deleted, and an import will not delete them for you.

stale.empty.purpose: Says there are no playlists to delete.
stale.empty.where: After-send lists, stale-playlists section, when the check ran and found none.

stale.unchecked.purpose: Says the check hasn't run because no rekordbox export was read.
stale.unchecked.where: After-send lists, stale-playlists section, when there's no export read to compare against.
stale.unchecked.approved: Not checked yet (no rekordbox export read)

stale.emptyFolder.purpose: Says a stale folder holds nothing.
stale.emptyFolder.where: After-send lists, detail beside a stale folder with no children.

stale.folderNoPlaylists.purpose: Says a stale folder holds only sub-folders, no playlists.
stale.folderNoPlaylists.where: After-send lists, detail beside a stale folder with sub-folders but no playlists.

stale.folderInside_one.purpose: Says a stale folder holds one playlist.
stale.folderInside_one.where: After-send lists, detail beside a stale folder with exactly one playlist inside.

stale.folderInside_other.purpose: Says a stale folder holds several playlists.
stale.folderInside_other.where: After-send lists, detail beside a stale folder with several playlists inside.

removals.title.purpose: Heading of the list of tracks to remove in rekordbox by hand.

removals.hint.purpose: Explains why the user removes these tracks and where they come from.
removals.hint.where: After-send lists, under the removals heading.
removals.hint.approved: In rekordbox, select these tracks, right-click and choose Remove from Collection. They were removed from your Library, and an import will not remove them for you.

removals.empty.purpose: Says there are no tracks to remove.
removals.empty.where: After-send lists, removals section, when nothing was removed from the Library that rekordbox still holds.

removals.trackName.purpose: How a track with an artist is named in the list.
removals.trackName.where: After-send lists, removals rows ({{artist}} and {{title}} come from the track).

removals.unnamed.purpose: Names a track that has neither title nor file name.
removals.unnamed.where: After-send lists, removals rows, for a track with no title and no file path.

removals.sentTo.purpose: Tooltip explaining the path shown under a removed track.
removals.sentTo.where: After-send lists, hover title of the file path in a removals row.
